race.description: Save The Date Sunday 1st November Melbourne Cup Calcutta Draw Falvey’s Hotel Gatton Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: QUALITY MISS (9) is the one to beat after her recent win here, edging Besiege by half a length at good odds. That performance followed a solid rebound from her Class 2 run at Sunshine Coast. Her 2000m record, wet-track ability, and venue familiarity make her a strong contender. VICTORY COMMAND (1) shows consistent form, finishing strongly for second at Gold Coast and placing at Dalby, with first-time blinkers and an apprentice claim keeping him competitive. HEADLINE LEGEND (5) struggled behind QUALITY MISS here, but his decisive Talwood BM55 win previously indicates he can perform under suitable conditions, making him a potential player for exotics. PAPAL MISS (7) is on a quick turnaround after a solid third over 2000m at Gold Coast Poly nine days ago. Has the inside gate and a bold showing is likely.
